first_compile_failure_preserved: history/nssoc-div2-native-01: OpenVAF parallel runtime failed under 2 GiB; one-thread compile fixed runtime configuration. No native functional result existed in that failed attempt.
historical_quick_scope: The earlier quick producer lacked the final full-current/latency guards. Its original producer and raw result are retained as history, not substituted for the final run.
scope: Actual frozen native VCO drives a two-native-latch toggle prescaler, nominally 8.01933 GHz to 4.00961 GHz. Four required finite operating cases pass. Cold exploratory VCE failures and hot exploratory initialization warnings prevent full PVT qualification.
limitations: One simulator ngspice 47 native campaign; no ngspice 42 cross-version run.
No full 81-corner matrix, statistical mismatch, phase noise, random jitter, or RF/package extraction.
Finite 4–12 ns measurement window after the actual zero-source supply ramp; minimum VCE is an operating-window screen. Maximum VCE and collector-current density cover the entire 0–12 ns capture.
Analytical pytest waveforms test measurement predicates only; transistor evidence comes exclusively from the retained native waveforms.
No PCIe link or PLL/CDR compliance claim.
